title: 音響・映像概論
subtitle: Introduction to Acoustics and Imaging
teachers:
SHIMAUCHI Suehiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn basic concepts of acoustics and optics.
(2)	learn basic properties of human auditory and visual perceptions.
(3)	learn basic theories of audio and video signal processing.
(4)	learn basic schemes of audio and video signal transmission.
(5)	learn basic schemes of audio and video signal recording.
advice:
This is a basic course to introduce acoustics and imaging. We will cover the following materials:

1.	Basic concepts of acoustics and optics
2.	Basic properties of human auditory and visual perceptions
3.	Basic theories of audio and video signal processing
4.	Basic schemes of audio and video signal transmission
5.	Basic schemes of audio and video signal recording

Students should be aware of teacher's instructions in class, since the schedules of lectures, exams and reports may change for their better understanding.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students should bring a scientific calculator for computational exercises in class.

This course will be followed by "Acoustic Engineering", "Acoustic and Imaging Systems", and "Optical Information Engineering".
books:
Textbooks: Multimedia System Technology (in Japanese) [Corona publishing]
Reference books: Introduction to Sound and Audio (in Japanese) [Corona publishing], Basic Studies of Video Systems -Fundamental Technologies for Digitization and their Applications- (in Japanese) [Corona publishing]
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
Basic knowledge related to "Electric Circuits I", "Electric Circuits II", and "Electromagnetics I".

              Students will:
(1)	learn basic concepts of acoustics and optics.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course to introduce acoustics and imaging. We will cover the following materials:

1.	Basic concepts of acoustics and optics
2.	Basic properties of human auditory and visual perceptions
3.	Basic theories of audio and video signal processing
4.	Basic schemes of audio and video signal transmission
5.	Basic schemes of audio and video signal recording

Students should be aware of teacher's instructions in class, since the schedules of lectures, exams and reports may change for their better understanding.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students should bring a scientific calculator for computational exercises in class.

This course will be followed by "Acoustic Engineering", "Acoustic and Imaging Systems", and "Optical Information Engineering".
